caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, monochrome (black and white) illustration of a mug with a large handle on the right side, standing on three ornate legs. The mug has a cylindrical body with slightly flared top and bottom edges, and features intricate decorative patterns, including a central medallion with floral and scrollwork motifs on its front side. The material appears metallic, suggested by the shading and reflection lines on the surface. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, there is a small, simplified side-view diagram of the mug showing its proportions and dimensions. The entire drawing is set within a rectangular border on a cream-colored background, and the artist's signature, "S. Weis," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Mug
